messages:
Elaine: Quick triage — we've collected wishlist from 3 pilot customers. Key asks: per-route batching/caching suggestions, quantization guidance, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we scope an alpha that is small but testable? cc Ming, Raj
Ming: For alpha I'd aim for a backend suggestion engine + a CLI/SDK hook + a tiny Console panel. No automatic apply in alpha; recommendations only and an opt-in apply button.
Raj: Eval-alerts idea: start with threshold-based alerts over a curated 'golden' prompt set. Support custom metric hooks. Recommend starting with perplexity + a task-specific metric (e.g., F1 for rerank).
Olivia: Customers also asked for quant presets by instance class. We can ship two presets: "latency-optimized" and "cost-optimized" (8-bit). Need runtime confirmation for safe fallback to FP16.
Sam: Ops note — telemetry & PII: we should only sample prompts and store hashes + metrics. Must include an opt-out flag and PII scrubber. Also add KMS audit for any config changes.
Jordan: From CS: pilots will join if we commit to weekly syncs and a short SLA: rollback within 24h if a change causes regressions. They want gating: no more than X regressions in top-10 prompts.
Ming: Rough sizing: suggestion engine + small inference scoring job + UI -> ~3 sprints across eng+ml. Alerts + eval infra -> additional 2 sprints. Quant preset testing depends on runtime team, estimate 2 sprints.
Elaine: Proposed alpha priorities: (1) batching/caching suggestions (MUST), (2) eval-triggered alerts (BASIC), (3) quant presets (OPTIONAL if time). Launch criteria: suggestion end-to-end, alerting end-to-end against pilot evals, onboarding docs + pilot agreements.
Raj: Suggested metric definitions for launch doc: recommendation adoption rate (how often customers apply suggestion within 7 days), false-alert rate <5%, and no CPU/GPU spike >10% after applied changes.
Olivia: UX mock: small Console card that shows Suggested config + estimated delta: latency %, cost %. Example payload we can surface:
```
suggest: {
  route: '/chat',
  batch_size: 32,
  cache_ttl_seconds: 600,
  quant_preset: 'int8'
}
```
Jordan: Pilot candidates: KudoHealth, Nota, LumenAI — all expressed interest. I'll confirm contacts and ask for their golden prompts and acceptance criteria.
Sam: Ops rollout checklist: sampling rate set, opt-out toggle on by default = false, audit log for each applied suggestion, manual rollback + telemetry to verify rollback. Also need runbook for noisy alerts.
Elaine: Action items: Ming -> RFC with scope + rough timelines by EOD Fri; Raj -> eval scaffold + metric hooks; Jordan -> confirm pilot contacts & NDA; Sam -> sketch ops checklist; I'll consolidate and schedule a 30m triage Monday. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: RFC template created at /docs/rfcs/toolkit-alpha.md
thread_text: Quick triage for toolkit alpha: prioritizing batching/caching recommendations, quant presets, and eval-triggered alerts; scope negotiation for a small pilot-ready alpha
